ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   D. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   B. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   B. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

10. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   D. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   D. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   B. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Tanzania and Uganda 4.3 Muslim scholars . Page 16 of 80 1 STRAND 1.0: S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Tanzania and Uganda and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim scholars . Page 16 of 80 1 STRAND 1.0: STUDY OF THE QURAN AND HADITH and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim scholars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
